thread:
frida: quick heads-up — saw an API key printed in a staging pod's logs during a failed deploy. it's the key for service-order-ingress. Need a quick plan: rotate, scrub logs, who can approve KMS/HSM unwrapping for CI? :rotating_light:
samir: yikes. first step: rotate the key in Vault ASAP and set the service to use the new key. scrub the logs before anyone else pulls them. also rotate any downstream tokens derived from that key.
kevin: I can scrub the logs. run something like:
```
sed -E -i 's/(API_KEY=)[^\s]+/\1<REDACTED>/g' /var/log/*staging*.log
```
then reindex the staging logs so they disappear from ES/Kibana.
olivia: who in infra can create an HSM-wrapped key or rewrap an existing one? my read is only infra-kms-admins can.
alice-sre: tag @sec-ops in the ticket. we need an approval for granting kms:Decrypt or hsm:unwrap to the CI service account. if this is urgent i can rubber-stamp an emergency grant (with a follow-up audit) once there's a ticket with details.
sec-ops: please include the pod name, the last 4 chars of the leaked key, and repro steps. we'll validate before approving any unwrap. also recommend rotating credentials that the token could access.
infra-bot: rotation runbook -> https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotation (steps: 1) create new key in Vault, 2) wrap with HSM, 3) update service account, 4) rotate consumer tokens, 5) revoke old key)
samir: small follow-up: add a sanitizer to the deploy pipeline to avoid envs in logs. e.g. add `--env-redact` to the shipper and a linter job that fails on patterns like `API_KEY=`.
frida: i'll open a ticket now with pod name, old key suffix, and a link to the suspicious log snippet. pinging @alice-sre for emergency approval. i'll rotate and update creds this afternoon and post back. :thumbsup:
kevin: ping me when the scrub and rotation are done and i'll validate logs are cleaned from the index.
frida: thanks — will update in the ticket when completed.
